mappings.note: This verse contains the title and musical instructions ('Au maître-chantre...') which are not present in the OSMAIN text.
Translation v2 contains only the narrative introduction ('Lorsque les Ziphiens...'). The OSMAIN v1 combines this narrative with the prayer text found in Translation v3.
Translation v3 contains the prayer ('O Dieu, sauve-moi...') which is the second half of OSMAIN v1.
Content matches perfectly: 'Hør min bønn' / 'écoute ma prière'.
Content matches perfectly regarding the enemies and the Selah marker.
Translation v6 is cut off mid-sentence ('...parmi ceux'). OSMAIN v4 contains the complete sentence ending with 'som støtter mitt liv'.
Content matches perfectly regarding God's judgment on enemies.
Content matches perfectly regarding the voluntary offering and praise.
The translation adds 'avec joie' (with joy) which is not present in the OSMAIN text ('mitt øye har sett på mine fiender'). The OSMAIN text does not specify the emotion of seeing.

extraContent.description: Title and musical instructions: 'Au maître-chantre. Cantique de David, avec les instruments à cordes;'
Added emotional descriptor: 'avec joie' (with joy) in the phrase regarding seeing enemies.
